title: Lower mass bound from a monotone weighted ratio whose limit density is at least 1
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (Λ ρ σ θ : ℝ) (m : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞), 1 ≤ θ → 0 < σ → σ < ρ → MonotoneOn (fun τ : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (Λ * τ) / τ ^ n) * m τ) (Ioo 0 ρ) → Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => m τ / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (τ ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (ENNReal.ofReal θ)) → ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(Λ * σ))) * (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (σ ^ n)) ≤ m σ
